name: Capital neutrality

subjectOf.text: Because reputation scales the reward, a node with less stake but high reputation may end up with more rewards than a node with more stake but less reputation.
subjectOf.abstract: Furthermore, a node with less stake but high reputation may end up with more rewards than a node with more stake but less reputation.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hybrid Secure Proof of Stake (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3931933

subjectOf.text: Reputation in HSPoS is a form of social capital earned by participating in the network's ecosystem, independent of the participant's financial capacity.
subjectOf.abstract: Reputation represents a type of social capital that is earned by participating in the network's ecosystem regardless of the amount of financial capacity.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hybrid Secure Proof of Stake (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3931933
